steps.note: Start the eRFX draft creation flow.
Enable eRFX projects for the draft creation flow.
Apply the required tenant configuration that prevents vendor additions during event creation.

Give the draft a stable title so it can be reopened from Drafts.
Create the RFQ-only eRFX stage required by the saved draft scenario.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.

Complete the pricing sheet so the draft can be saved.

Save the eRFX event as an unpublished draft.
Navigate to the events list to access the saved draft.
Verify the newly saved draft is present in the Drafts tab.
Establish that the event is still an unpublished draft before editing terms.
Open the saved draft as the buyer.
